March 12, 2018 - By Vivian Park 
Foundry Partners Llc increased its stake in Glatfelter (GLT) by 35.12% based on its latest 2017Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. Foundry Partners Llc bought 99,845 shares as the company’s stock declined 23.06% while stock markets rallied. The institutional investor held 384,180 shares of the paper company at the end of 2017Q3, valued at $7.47M, up from 284,335 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Foundry Partners Llc who had been investing in Glatfelter for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $969.89 million market cap company. The stock increased 0.09% or $0.02   $22.2. About 93,506 shares traded. P. H. Glatfelter Company (NYSE:GLT) has declined 7.25% since March 12, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 23.95% the S&P500.

It also reduced its holding in Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 8,697 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 90,192 shares, and cut its stake in Pnc Finl Svcs Group Inc (NYSE:PNC).
